g.text: A complete source can miss an earlier obligation.

g.text: Original obligations remain after edits; stale results are not fresh success.

g.text: Live lookahead changes may alter queues and obsolete work.

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Source-ready excludes preparation, enqueue and acoustics.

text.style: font-size: 11.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Zero observed misses does not bound future tail risk.

font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Vary time budget, admitted load, search policy and edit trace. Fix and record delivery, temporal contract and fallback rules.

text.style: font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Measure stage waits + revisions + contiguous coverage; report continuity, fresh success, validity, response gap and quality separately.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: 90 cells: 5 tempos x 3 leads x 6 trace conditions. No resimulation of changed admission or queues; local preparation / enqueue / acoustics omitted.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: Sources: saved evidence JSON + raw SHA-256-verified traces; technical companion contains full definitions, registry crosswalk, code anchors and prior-paper reference.
